description: This file defines the HttpResponseTask class, a workflow activity for sending HTTP responses within OrchardCore workflows. It manages response headers, status code, content, and content type, and executes asynchronously to write the response.

classes.name: HttpResponseTask
classes.description: A workflow activity class for sending HTTP responses, including setting headers, status code, content, and content type, within OrchardCore workflows.

methods.name: HttpResponseTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the HttpResponseTask.

methods.name: DisplayText
methods.description: Returns the display name of the activity.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Returns the category of the activity, 'HTTP'.

methods.name: GetPossibleOutcomes
methods.description: Defines the possible outcomes of the activity, currently only 'Done'.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes the activity asynchronously, evaluating expressions for headers, content, and content type, then writing the response.

methods.name: ParseHeaders
methods.description: Parses header string into key-value pairs for response headers.
